decision: ENDORSE_SOURCE_SPECIFIC_SHELVE; NO IDENTIFIED NUMERICAL OR STANDALONE CLINICAL VALUE STAGE
review_fields: Original clinical source Methods definition, all11 full Table2 literal rows/asterisk footnote and allowed postoperative clinical paragraph; exact owner all-row map versus primary, prior-art external-control suggestion; no source expansion

source_and_units.cases: All11 native author EMC, each source NR4A3 rearrangement yes. One advanced chemotherapy cohort, not all EMC.
source_and_units.source_pfs_header: PFS, with no unit printed in header; months supported by cohort clinical statement. No claim of invalid units.
source_and_units.source_surgery_censor: Table2 footnote explicitly maps asterisk to surgery after chemotherapy/censoring at resection; exact caseIDs1,7,10.
source_and_units.remaining_eight: Plain durations lack row-specific terminal progression/death versus ordinary last-contact censor label; best RECIST is not substituted for that coding.
source_and_units.common_origin: Explicit treatment-start interval origin not authenticated in the inspected clinical Methods/definition. Conventional interpretation is possible, but frozen rule does not impute it. Missing terminal coding independently blocks all11 risk-set identification.
source_and_units.post_surgery: Source explicitly provides three later distant-relapse conditions from surgery; already reported by original authors. Not an added independent recurrence result.
source_and_units.case_independence: Single selected network/institutional series; possible later Italian anthracycline/sunitinib/clinical cohort overlap unresolved. No donor pooling or external replication.

estimand_challenge.surgery: An intercurrent treatment change, not progression/death. A fully observed first-surgery-versus-first-failure pathway could be analyzed descriptively; it would not estimate hypothetical no-surgery tumor PFS or drug efficacy. Surgery does not prevent future disease progression.
estimand_challenge.unknowns: No valid all11 six-month CIF, bootstrap or source-finite bound launched under original rule. Unknown durations/status/origin cannot be turned into failures, zeros, independent censoring or assumed post-surgery trajectories.
estimand_challenge.published_KM: The source may have used clinical data not represented in the table; missing public mapping does not establish that published KM was wrong or biased.
estimand_challenge.clinical_consequence: No numerically identified empirical result demonstrates external-control bias, treatment inferiority or surgery harm.

independent_value_judgment: The author suggestion of use as future external controls is a genuine existing claim, but this small selected series does not release the data needed for a discriminating empirical revision. Its surgical censorship and postoperative relapses were already published. Merely repeating informative-censoring caution or presenting a trivial unknown-state bound would not add useful EMC evidence. A credible source-dependent question remains open if actual histories and eligibility/covariates become public.

limits_and_exposure.own_source_exposure: Before review freeze: R7 verified aggregate responses/surgery censorship and owner surgery-ID/postoperative-link messages. After review freeze: all11 original PFS and RECIST literal cells, Methods cohort aggregate definitions and permitted postoperative clinical paragraph inspected for source audit. No claim of endpoint blinding after that audit; no survival probabilities or efficacy statistics computed.
limits_and_exposure.combined_team: R7 previous full-source exposure remains explicit. No globally blinded or novel-publication claim.
limits_and_exposure.audit_failure_preserved: Initial source-quote equality failed solely on NBSP/newline layout in Table/Figure references; normalized whitespace validation passes. Initial validation/correction retained; no source or scientific interpretation changed.
limits_and_exposure.coverage: This review covers exact11-row source/estimand/value scope, not a new all-public-EMC systematic review. Owner broader eligible/pending coverage remains operative; no source omitted from an advancing claim because nothing advances.

reopening: Public authentic individual treatment-origin, event/censor type, surgery dates, longitudinal post-surgery progression/death and last assessment plus source baseline/line/selection covariates, donor-overlap resolution, and a prospectively consequential external-control comparison beyond reported facts. All relevant EMC conditions and independent omission/value check required; no automatic paper promotion.
